QuestInfo.2:
Upon returning from the forest, the only item in your possession was a letter Destonen had written to his wife, Yuris.
Because Yuris had died, you decided to deliver it to his daughter, Kyrin.
Kyrin recognized her father's handwriting, and although see looked sad, it seemed that she was feeling his love being expressed through the letter.
You weren't able to change destiny, but it was very fortunate that you were able to convey Destonen's final words to his daughter.
